'''Pruss''' was a [[Sedrian]] hunter, and the son of dissidents who opposed the current Sedrian rulers. In the wake of the [[Golden Sun]] incident, Pruss ventured into the abandoned [[Imperial Aquatic Garrison]] after observing the [[Kerestian/Legends|Kerestian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Limna Yith]] hiding an object inside. The object&mdash;the [[Barani List]]&mdash;caused a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] band under the leadership of [[Gyran]] to massacre the dissidents to retrieve it, leaving Pruss as the only survivor.<ref name="SSR" />
